title: KANIT: an evidence-graded knowledge base of antimicrobial resistance biomarkers in the ESKAPEE pathogens
description: KANIT is a knowledge base of genomic biomarkers associated with antimicrobial resistance in the ESKAPEE pathogens. The biomarkers are unitigs that gradient-boosted models select under lineage-aware cross-validation. Each biomarker is examined by independent lines of evidence, which a fixed rule combines into one evidence grade. A grade states association with resistance, not that the biomarker causes it.
